evidence: Changes fuzz harness setup files and test utilities under src/test/fuzz/ and src/test/util/ to enable block filter indexing during P2P fuzzing.
rationale: Enables fuzz coverage for untested BIP 157 P2P message handling paths, immediately uncovering an unsigned integer overflow in net_processing. Category guidance prioritizes fuzz coverage of high-risk paths like P2P message handling, especially when catching realistic bugs.
